simplifications: A qualifying visit is any ambulatory or virtual encounter in the period, not the exact visit value sets in the spec.
Exclusions cover hospice and palliative care only. The frailty and advanced-illness exclusion for ages 66+ is not implemented.
Patients who died before the end of the period are left out.
Codes are matched on a few common Synthea codes, not full VSAC value sets.
Glucose management indicator (GMI) is not used for CMS122, only HbA1c.
